name: Connecting Ridge (Site 01)
description: High-altitude ridge connecting Shackleton and de Gerlache craters. High solar illumination (~80%) and candidate area for Artemis III.

name: Shackleton Crater Rim (Site 04)
description: Classic peak of near-permanent light candidate at 89.9°S. High solar exposure with severe Earth libration horizon dips.

name: Malapert Mountain (Site 07)
description: Massive 5 km elevated mountain providing nearly uninterrupted direct-to-Earth line of sight and wide regional communications coverage.

name: Haworth Crater Interior (Site 09)
description: Deep cryogenic Permanent Shadow Region (PSR) benchmark. 0% sunlight, steep wall approach hazards, and cold cryogenic regolith.
